questions.stem: Which of the following statements about diverticulitis is incorrect? Diverticulitis often presents with abdominal pain localized to the lower left side. A barium enema is a preferred imaging method for diagnosing diverticulitis. Colostomy is often performed as a first-line treatment. Stage Ib of the Modified Hinchey Classification refers to a pericolic abscess. Complications of diverticulitis may include fistula formation, such as colovesical fistula.
